# ecTools <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="139"/>

<!-- badges: start -->
[![CodeFactor](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/ninanor/ectools/badge)](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/ninanor/ectools) [![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/NINAnor/ecTools/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NINAnor/ecTools/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

The goal of ecTools is to provide tools for ecosystem accounting and assessments.

## Installation

You can install the development version of ecTools from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("NINAnor/ecTools")
```
## ecVerse

ecTools is part of **ecVerse - Ecosystem condition workflows for science and policy**
